about.label: About Natural Aceh
about.title: Progress grows when people and nature move forward
about.description: Natural Aceh is a research, training and philanthropy institution. We work with communities and partners on sustainable development programs across Aceh and Indonesia.

programs.title: Where change takes shape
programs.intro: Natural Aceh’s published programs connect women’s empowerment, community livelihoods, education and environmental stewardship.

cards.title: WPS Program
cards.detail: The Women, Peace and Security program includes work with coastal women on economic empowerment and sustainable livelihoods.

cards.title: Livelihood Program
cards.detail: Community livelihood work includes Natural Akademi, oyster-based enterprise and mangrove restoration activities.

cards.title: SDGs Program
cards.detail: Initiatives include coastal ecosystem restoration, disaster risk reduction education and community health.

belief.description: From coastal livelihoods to education and environmental stewardship, lasting change starts by listening to local knowledge and making room for local leadership.

stories.title: Stories of progress
stories.source: Selected stories from Natural Aceh’s published news archive.

items.title: Protecting Environmental Defenders, Combating the Criminalization of Activists in Indonesia
items.summary: A report on the legal threats and criminalization faced by environmental defenders in Indonesia.

items.title: Guardians of Aceh: Indigenous Wisdom in the Climate Crisis
items.summary: The story follows Panglima Laot, Keujrun Blang and Pawang Uteen as they protect Aceh’s sea, farmland and forests amid climate pressures.

items.title: Enhancing Community Engagement in Malaria Prevention and Response in Aceh
items.summary: The article focuses on malaria prevention for fishing and farming communities in remote parts of Aceh.
